# Caesura

> Bringhurst-inspired classical book typography. Part of The Collective Style Guide Library.

Old-style serif body, Myriad-lineage chrome, oxblood accent on warm cream. Hanging punctuation, optical alignment, generous leading. Voice runs literary and considered.

## Use this variant for

Writing tools, reading apps, knowledge tools that prize craft, slow-tech products.

## Modes & densities

- Modes: `light`, `dark`. Densities: `comfortable`, `compact`. RTL: supported.

## Quick token reference (light)

- bg: #FBF8F2 / surface: #FFFFFF / text: #1A1817 / border: #C9C0B0
- accent: #6B1F1F (oxblood)
- radius: 0 / serif body: minion-pro / sans chrome: myriad-pro

## Resources

- [Tokens](./tokens.json) / [Principles](./principles.md) / [Content](./content.md) / [Motion](./motion.md) / [i18n](./i18n.md) / [Starter prompt](./starter-prompt.md) / [Components](./components.json)

## Install

```ts
import { theme } from "@collective/caesura";
import { ThemeProvider } from "@collective/foundation";
<ThemeProvider theme={theme}><YourApp /></ThemeProvider>
```
